purpose: Civil budget opportunity comparison; source projection and hypothetical scenario are separate records.

sourceProjection.title: Projected Costs of U.S. Nuclear Forces, 2025 to 2034
sourceProjection.budgetRequestBasis: Fiscal year 2025 DoD and DOE budget requests submitted in March 2024

components.labelDe: Modernisierung von Führung, Kommunikation und Frühwarnung

limitations: This conditional projection is not an enacted appropriation, actual spending total or available cash balance.
It does not estimate how much could actually be redirected by disarmament.
The 129 billion USD component estimates possible cost growth; it is not a separately available fund.
CBO excludes several nuclear legacy costs, including dismantlement of retired weapons and cleanup of past contamination.
No economic multiplier, health effect, damage amount or individual legal entitlement is inferred.

syntheticExample.scenarioWindow: 2025-2034; chosen solely to illustrate arithmetic over one common window
syntheticExample.interpretation: All scenario inputs are illustrative assumptions. The result demonstrates arithmetic, not realizable savings, GDP growth, a payment promise or a compensation claim.
